description: This file provides utility functions for processing HTML content, including sanitization, conversion to markdown and text, and extracting readable content using Mozilla's Readability library. It handles HTML parsing, entity decoding, and content extraction with depth and size heuristics.

methods.name: loadReadabilityDeps
methods.description: Loads dependencies for Mozilla Readability and linkedom dynamically, with caching and error handling.

methods.name: decodeEntities
methods.description: Decodes HTML entities in a string to their corresponding characters.

methods.name: stripTags
methods.description: Removes HTML tags from a string, decoding entities.

methods.name: normalizeWhitespace
methods.description: Normalizes whitespace in a string, trimming and reducing multiple spaces/newlines.

methods.name: htmlToMarkdown
methods.description: Converts HTML content to markdown-like text, extracting title and formatting headers, links, lists, and line breaks.

methods.name: markdownToText
methods.description: Converts markdown text to plain text by removing markdown syntax.

methods.name: truncateText
methods.description: Truncates a string to a maximum number of characters, indicating if truncated.

methods.name: exceedsEstimatedHtmlNestingDepth
methods.description: Heuristically checks if HTML content exceeds a nesting depth threshold to prevent deep parsing.

methods.name: extractBasicHtmlContent
methods.description: Sanitizes HTML and extracts plain text and title based on extract mode.

methods.name: extractReadableContent
methods.description: Uses Mozilla Readability to extract main content and title from HTML, with size and depth heuristics.
